_comment: One integer unit follows B's match_engine/config/pairs.json (team decision 19 Nov): price_decimals 2, qty_decimals 6, USDT 6 decimals, and the same tick and lot as B and D. price x qty stays exact because one tick (0.01) times one lot (0.0001 BTC, 0.001 ETH) is a whole number of USDT units; the loader checks it. min_qty, max_qty and max_notional are A's own limits (100 BTC, 1000 ETH, 1,000,000 USDT per order).
